scope: Displayed SVG crops only; original raster bytes remain embedded and are licensed/attributed. This is not a claim that the uncropped source contains no other subject.
method: All150 final Chromium-rendered views were visually inspected in ten15-image contact sheets; source pages/metadata and hardware/model facts were cross-checked. Inverse SVG geometry separately verifies that detail views cannot escape their reviewed primary crop.
limitations: Some primary images are close-ups rather than whole-device/three-angle photos. Hands without an identifiable person may be visible. Device-maker markings belonging to the photographed model remain; third-party advertising/app logos, price placards, readable price overlays and identifiable people are excluded from the displayed clips.
